title: TRIPPULSE: Multi-Agent Travel Planning with Review-Grounded Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30924v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Travel itinerary generation requires balancing strict spatio-temporal constraints with human preferences. Existing LLM-based planners mainly rely on structured attributes and pre- defined traveler personas, but real travel deci- sions are often shaped by reviews that reveal experiential factors such as comfort, safety, ser- vice quality, ambiance, crowding, and hidden risks absent from structured databases. Incor- porating such review information is therefore critical to realistic, user-centric itinerary gen- eration. We propose TRIPPULSE1, a multi- agent framework for review-grounded travel planning. Instead of relying on a monolithic planner (and face context and reasoning bot- tlenecks), TRIPPULSE2 decomposes itinerary generation into specialized agents (each op- erating over localized contexts) for accom- modations, transportation, meals, attractions, and events, coordinated through a global or- chestrator with scheduling mechanisms

translated_title: TRIPPULSE：基于评论推理的多智能体旅行规划
translated_abstract: 旅行行程生成需要在严格的时空约束与人类偏好之间取得平衡。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的规划器主要依赖结构化属性和预先定义的旅行者画像，但真实的旅行决策往往受到评论的影响，这些评论揭示了诸如舒适度、安全性、服务质量、氛围、拥挤程度以及结构化数据库中缺失的隐藏风险等体验性因素。因此，融入此类评论信息对于实现真实且以用户为中心的行程生成至关重要。我们提出了TRIPPULSE，一个基于评论的旅行规划多智能体框架。TRIPPULSE不依赖单一的规划器（从而避免面临上下文和推理瓶颈），而是将行程生成分解为专门的智能体（每个智能体在局部上下文中运行），分别负责住宿、交通、餐饮、景点和活动，并通过带有调度机制的全局编排器进行协调。
tldr: 提出了TRIPPULSE多智能体框架，将旅行行程生成任务分解为住宿、交通、餐饮、景点等专项智能体，并利用用户评论中的体验性信息（如舒适度、安全性、服务质量等）进行基于评论的推理，通过全局编排器协调，生成更真实、以用户为中心的旅行行程。
en_tdlr: TRIPPULSE is a multi-agent travel planning framework that decomposes itinerary generation into specialized agents for accommodations, transportation, meals, attractions, and events, leveraging review-grounded experiential reasoning and a global orchestrator to produce realistic, user-centric travel plans.
